title: Intervyu Na Rtvi S Mariannoy Minsker
description: Intervyu o politike, ekonomike i obschestve c Mariannoy Minsker. Razgovor s nyusmeykerami, ekspertami i intellektualami, kotorye opredelyayut povestku ili sposobny ee pereosmyslit.

title: Chuzhoy
description: Glavnyy geroy seriala, Mikhail Aristov, posle razvoda prinimaet reshenie vernut'sya na rodinu iz Avstralii, gde rabotal reyndzherom v natsional'nom parke. On absolyutno ne predstavlyaet sebe realiy zhizni v sovremennoy Rossii.

title: Detskoe Chtivo
description: Detskoe chtivo - proekt, kotoryy perevorachivaet predstavlenie o slozhnom: nikakih skuchnyh lektsiy, tolko dinamichnye video, memy i chestnyy razgovor na ravnyh. Nauchnye i kulturnye kontseptsii - prostym yazykom, s sovremennoy grafikoy i realnymi.

title: RTVI Voda - novaya neft
description: Together with glaciologist Bakyt Ermenbaev, Arseniy Molchanov embarks on a challenging mountain trek to Kyrgyzstan to see the melting Golubin Glacier and collect snow samples.

title: Legenda
description: Etih lyudey pomnit i znaet vsya strana. Oni s dostoinstvom proshli ispytanie slavoy. Oni kumiry millionov. Aktery, politiki, muzykanty, uchenye i sportsmeny - lichno povedayut o teh, urokah, kotorye oni perezhili.

title: Nebesnyy sud
description: Advokaty Andrey i Veniamin - druz'ya, no rabota to i delo stavit ikh na raznye storony barrikad. Osobennost' ikh polozheniya v tom, chto sudebnye protsessy, v kotorykh oni uchastvuyut, proiskhodyat ne v zemnoy zhizni, a v zagrobnoy.
